story.what: Baseline. A few warm nights; nothing stands out.
Warm nights with ~3 AM wake-ups become frequent. Cycle lengths start to swing (26 → 38 → 22 days).
She buys cooling pillowcases, moisture-wicking pajamas, melatonin and a bedside fan.
Books her annual exam for Sep 2 (confirmation email).
The agent asks a handful of one-tap questions ('Did you have a drink last night?').
Annual exam with Dr. Elena Ruiz; follow-up booked for Nov 10.
Picks up a new prescription (pharmacy email has no drug name); confirms in one tap it is a new treatment.
Warm nights fall off over ~3 weeks. Drinking stays about the same. Refills on time (Oct 3, Nov 2).
Work trip to Seattle (flight + hotel emails).
